Let \(f: [-1,3] \to [-43,-3]\) be the function defined by
\(f{\left(x \right)} = - x^{2} + 12 x - 30\).
Verify that \(f\) is bijective, and compute the inverse function \(f^{-1}:[-43,-3] \to [-1,3]\).
You may type sqrt(2) for the square root of 2 for example.
